meta.indiceDescription: DaleControl Barber against Booksy, Fresha and AgendaPro: pricing, how each one charges, WhatsApp included and per-client commissions. Data reviewed on {fecha}.
meta.competidorTitle: DaleControl Barber vs {competidor}: an honest comparison
meta.competidorDescription: Pricing, billing model, WhatsApp and commissions of {competidor} against DaleControl Barber. With sources and dates. Data reviewed on {fecha}.

indice.lede: If you already pay for barbershop software, this is what changes when you move. No tricks: every price is the one each company publishes, with its source and its date.
indice.tablaLede: Each one has its own page with the detail, the sources and where it beats us.
indice.panoramaLede: They do not have their own page yet, but if you are comparing they deserve a place on the map.
indice.nosotrosNota: Priced per plan, not per barber. WhatsApp included and no per-client commission.

tabla.notaComparabilidad: Every price is shown exactly as each company publishes it. Only AgendaPro states that theirs are listed before tax; for the others we did not verify the tax treatment, so we do not claim it.

escenarios.titulo: The math, out in the open
escenarios.lede: Their pricing and ours do not work the same way, so comparing them head to head would be dishonest. This is what a barbershop would pay in subscription, by team size.
escenarios.soloSuscripcion: This is the subscription only. Marketplace per-client commissions are charged separately and depend on how many people arrive through it, so they cannot go into a table without guessing.

fortalezas.lede: If we only said we win at everything, you would have no reason to believe us. This is real, and it is theirs.

ventajas.lede: Our defensible difference is short: WhatsApp is genuinely included and we charge no per-client commission. The rest is noise.

reportes.aviso: These are public third-party reviews, not our own experience and not an accusation: we cite them as what they are, user reports. Judge them yourself.

fuentes.verifica: Prices change without notice. Before you decide, verify every number on each company's own site.
fuentes.sinEnlace: No direct link: check it on their official site.

cta.titulo: Try it with your own barbershop
cta.lede: Prices in pesos, WhatsApp included in the plan and not a single peso of commission on your clients.

footer.aviso: Booksy, Fresha, AgendaPro, Squire, Amyra and BarberLab are trademarks of their respective companies and are not affiliated with DaleControl. What we say about each one comes from what they publish on their sites and from public user reviews, reviewed on {fecha}.
